source: NASADEM (NASA JPL, 1 arc-second, SRTM-based, year-2000 surface) via the Microsoft Planetary Computer collection 'nasadem' (anonymous); reprojected bilinearly to UTM 22S at 30 m; slope = 100 x the magnitude of the elevation gradient (numpy.gradient, central differences)
cropland_mask: ESA WorldCover 2021 class 40, >= 50% of the 30 m pixel, inside IBGE municipality 4306106
norm_rule: IN SPA/MAPA 2/2025 item 3.2.1 I: slope >= 3% requires contour sowing (or sowing on the level) on at least 75% of the area in the last year, otherwise the management level is NM1. The norm defines no other slope class.
context_classes_note: Relief classes used by Embrapa soil surveys (flat 0-3%, gently undulating 3-8%, undulating 8-20%, strongly undulating 20-45%); context only, not classes of the norm.
warning: The satellite and the DEM do not see contour sowing, terraces or sowing on the level: they only say where the rule applies (slope >= 3%), not whether the field complies. NASADEM noise at 30 m inflates slope on gentle relief; a field's mean slope (item 6.3) can differ from the pixel shares here.
